attachments.origin_landmark: long head: ischial tuberosity (with semitendinosus, via conjoint tendon); short head: linea aspera of femur (femur_r)

functional_compartments.name: Long head
functional_compartments.function_note: Crosses both hip and knee; extends hip in addition to flexing knee.
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset; Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell)

functional_compartments.name: Short head
functional_compartments.innervation_branch: common fibular (peroneal) division of sciatic n.
functional_compartments.function_note: Crosses only the knee; textbook example of a single named muscle with heads innervated by different divisions of the parent nerve (tibial vs common fibular) and different actions (no hip extension).
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset; Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell)

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset

ultrasound_injection_approach.transducer_placement: Transverse on the distal third of the posterior thigh, lateral portion.
ultrasound_injection_approach.depth_layer: Lies directly over the femoral cortex at this level.
ultrasound_injection_approach.notes: Implicated in the excessive-knee-flexion gait pattern. The source states its arborization percentages along the femoral condyles (0%) to ischial tuberosity (100%) line, but those values sit in a list that full-text extraction dropped, so no motor_endplate_zones entry is recorded for this muscle. The reference line is known; the numbers are not, and are not inferred from the neighbouring hamstrings.
ultrasound_injection_approach.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity: Part III -- Proximal Lower Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(5):240 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17050240 -- review synthesis of the intramuscular neural arborization literature it cites
